Title: Public preview: Static Web Apps now supports Gitlab and Bitbucket for CI/CD

Body.Content:
Bring your Gitlab or Bitbucket project, create a simple YAML file using the provided template, and link it to a Static Web App created with a custom deployment source.

To learn more about Gitlab, visit: https://aka.ms/swagitlabsupport.

To learn more about Bitbucket, visit: https://aka.ms/swabitbucketsupport.
